name: DINKFLIX Web
overview: A premium, lightweight desktop redesign for Jellyfin Web.
description: DINKFLIX Web replaces the desktop Jellyfin Web browsing experience with its own navigation, cinematic Recently Added hero, Continue Watching and discovery rows, separate Movies and TV Shows libraries, My List, search, rich title details and a human project page.
